name: mailgw-monorepo
description: Mail gateway monorepo (Haraka router + log service)

scripts.start: docker compose up -d && pnpm run provision
scripts.dev: docker compose up -d && pnpm run provision
scripts.check: cd mailgw-go && gofmt -l . && go vet ./... && go test ./... && cd ../logservice-go && gofmt -l . && go vet ./... && go test ./...
scripts.docs:build: pnpm --filter mailgw-docs-public build && pnpm --filter mailgw-docs-internal build && pnpm --filter mailgw-docs-testing build
scripts.test: pnpm run test:mailgw-go && pnpm run test:logservice-go && pnpm run test:logservice
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run provision && SMTP_PORT=2525 MAILGW_API_E2E=1 MAILGW_DB_CHECK=1 bun test ./tests/
scripts.test:e2e:smtp: pnpm run provision && SMTP_PORT=2525 MAILGW_DB_CHECK=1 bun test ./tests/smtp/
scripts.test:e2e:smtp:go: SMTP_PORT=2525 pnpm run provision && SMTP_PORT=2525 bun test ./tests/smtp/
scripts.test:e2e:gateway: pnpm run build:mailgw-go:test:bin && MAILGW_REQUIRE_TIER_B=1 bun test ./tests/gw/
scripts.test:e2e:stack: pnpm run provision && SMTP_PORT=2525 bun test ./tests/stack/
scripts.stack:test: MAILGW_GO_TEST_VERSION=$(cat mailgw-go/VERSION) docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml -f docker-compose.test.yaml up -d && pnpm run provision
scripts.docker:push: bash mailgw-go/bump.sh && pnpm run build:mailgw-go && bash logservice-go/bump.sh && pnpm run build:logservice-go && pnpm run build:webui
scripts.build:containers: pnpm run docker:push && pnpm run build:legacy:mailgw

author: Aibulat
